description: Index of t.ROY / coach doctrine skills. THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what skills exist and when they load. Adding a skill = add an entry here + a folder `<id>/SKILL.md` (optionally with companion data: facts.json, scripts, examples). No code change needed -- lib/skills-loader.ts reads this. Activation: a skill loads when the current page is in `pages` (any user), or in `pagesIfCriminalRecord` when the user disclosed a record, or when `always` is true. Page ids: forge = intro/welcome/resume/goals/story/preferences/processing/output/rush; dashboard = dashboard/application-tailor/jobs/disclosure/disclosure-rehearsal/interview/vault/employers/resources/applications/progress/settings.

skills.title: Agency & Corrections
skills.summary: t.ROY is an agent, not a chatbot: the correction ladder (fix now -> route to the edit surface -> regenerate -> tool-apply with confirm-card -> file to Troy), filing standards, power boundaries, identity-propagation rule.

skills.title: Career Narrative
skills.summary: Anti-fragility doctrine, the 5-part narrative arc, gap handling, the turning-point story. The philosophical foundation every other skill builds on.

skills.title: The Truth Gate
skills.summary: The first law: nothing generated asserts a fact the user did not provide. Why it is absolute for this population, what strength-without-invention looks like, how to decline invention requests.

skills.title: Bullet Mining
skills.summary: The five gold-mining questions (did/tools/often/how many/improved), mining technique (chase the 'just', translate don't transcribe), the bullet formula, identity payoff.

skills.title: Inside Experience Reframe
skills.summary: Work/training while incarcerated is REAL experience: translation patterns (facility kitchen -> institutional kitchen), the two failure modes (erasure and exposure), never carceral words on paper.

skills.title: Gap Navigation
skills.summary: Gaps handled structurally on paper (years-only, hybrid layouts, fill with what was true, never explain) and verbally in interviews (the rehearsed three-beat answer).

skills.title: Application Tailoring
skills.summary: One base, many aims: what tailoring changes (summary, emphasis, skill selection) and never changes (facts, certs, education), posting extraction, fit honesty, logistics truthfulness, cover-letter bar.

skills.title: ATS Safety & Formats
skills.summary: Honest ATS mechanics (parse-safety over score theater), single-column structure, true-keyword strategy, PDF/DOCX/TXT doctrine, export hygiene (user's brand only, no em dashes).

skills.title: Strong Background, Real Record
skills.summary: Coaching high-capability users with records: fast recognition, upgrading good resumes to the Steel Man bar, professional-stakes disclosure (licensing, deep checks, the network knows), dignity rules.

skills.title: Stage Adaptation
skills.summary: Prochaska stages operationalized: exploring/preparing/acting/maintaining, depth and tone per stage, identity-evidence coaching (Giordano), never fake-promote or gatekeep.

skills.title: Predictive Helpfulness
skills.summary: The coach who moves first: the where/what-changed/what's-next loop, the proactive playbook (resume->job, job->tailor, plan->rehearse, 5-day follow-up), one offer at a time, constraint-checked, channel respect.

skills.title: Job Search Doctrine
skills.summary: Real jobs first with real pay; rate the MATCH never the person; fair-chance as an honest 3-tier overlay (verified/public-signal/unknown) woven under live listings; overlap floats to top; transportation reality; search craft.

skills.title: Rejection Recovery
skills.summary: Triage after a no: acknowledge, right-size, read the pattern for the failing stage, smallest next true step; disclosure-shaped rejections; protecting the user's story; crisis boundaries; banking wins.

skills.title: Disclosure Coaching
skills.summary: Troy's disclosure doctrine: timing strategy, the 4-part structure, follow-up handling, anti-patterns, and industry + legal scaffolding (with the WOTC / legal-claim discipline).
